class.name: NetwSchema
class.brief_description: A named list of typed columns.
class.description:
Declare it in a [code]static var[/code] beside the code that writes it. Every peer built from the same scripts ends up with the same [member columns] in the same order. Each column method returns the column's index, which is how a writer and a reader name the column. [method Netw.table] opens the replicated table a session builds from the schema. [codeblock] class Mobs: static var schema := Netw.configure_schema(&"Mob") static var pos := schema.vector3( &"pos", NetwQuantizeScalar.new().limits(-512.0, 512.0).step(0.03), ) static var vel := schema.vector3(&"vel") # no quantizer, sent as raw bytes static var hp := schema.u16(&"hp")
@onready var mobs := Netw.table(self, Mobs.schema.schema_name) [/codeblock] A column with no quantizer is sent as a raw copy of its buffer, which is the cheapest to encode and decode. Add a quantizer to the columns where bandwidth matters. The same schema also types [NetwDatabase] records and [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] bindings. A schema used only for saves calls [method replicated] with [code]false[/code] so no table is created. [method string] and [method variant] columns work for saves but not for replicated tables.

method.name: boolean
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_BOOL] column, one bit per element on the wire.

method.name: color
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_COLOR] column.

method.name: column
method.description: Appends a column of [param type] and returns its index. The typed methods such as [method vector3] are this call with the type filled in. Declaring a [param key] again with the same [param type] and [param stride] returns the index it already has, so a script reload is safe. Declaring it with a different shape returns [code]-1[/code] and appends nothing.

method.name: column_ref
method.description: Returns a [NetwColumnRef] for the column at [param index], or [code]null[/code] when this schema has no such column. Configuration calls such as [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] take the reference.

method.name: create
method.description: Builds a schema under [param name] without adding it to the schema registry. Use [method Netw.configure_schema] to get the registered one, or call [method register] later.

method.name: declare
method.description: Returns the registered schema named [param name], creating it if needed, or [code]null[/code] when the name is empty. Calling it twice with one name returns the same schema, so several classes can add columns to it. [method Netw.configure_schema] calls this.

method.name: entity
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_ENTITY] column of routes, pointing at rows of another table.

method.name: f32
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_F32] column.

method.name: f64
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_F64] column.

method.name: i8
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I8] column.

method.name: i16
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I16] column.

method.name: i32
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I32] column.

method.name: i64
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_I64] column.

method.name: is_reliable
method.description: Whether this schema's table sends its commits reliably, as [method reliable] set it.

method.name: is_replicated
method.description: Whether a session creates a replicated table from this schema, as [method replicated] set it.

method.name: migrate
method.description:
Sets the function that upgrades a record saved under [param from_version] to the next version, and returns this schema. [param step] takes a [Dictionary] and returns a [Dictionary]. A save two versions behind runs two steps in order, and a read with a missing step fails. [codeblock] static var schema := NetwSchema.create(&"players") \ .replicated(false) \ .storage_version(2) \ .migrate(1, PlayerSave.add_position)
static func add_position(row: Dictionary) -> Dictionary: row[&"position"] = Vector2.ZERO return row [/codeblock] The stored record is not rewritten by the read. The next save writes it at the current version.

method.name: quaternion
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_QUATERNION] column, stored as a [PackedVector4Array] and read as [Quaternion] so [NetwQuantizeQuaternion] can compress it.

method.name: register
method.description: Adds this schema to the schema registry if it is not there, and returns it. A [code]static var[/code] runs only once, so call this from [method Node._ready] when the registry may have been reset since. It does nothing when the schema is already registered.

method.name: reliable
method.description: Sends this schema's table commits reliably, and returns this schema. Use it for a table that changes rarely, where a lost packet would not be fixed by the next commit. A table committed every tick is fine unreliable.

method.name: replicated
method.description: Sets whether a session creates a replicated table from this schema, and returns this schema. Pass [code]false[/code] for a schema that only describes saved records.

method.name: storage_version
method.description: Sets the version saved records of this schema carry, and returns this schema. The default is [code]1[/code]. Raise it when the saved columns change, and add a [method migrate] step from the previous version. It does not affect replication, so peers on different storage versions still connect.

method.name: string
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_STRING] column. Like [method variant], a schema holding one cannot become a replicated table.

method.name: u8
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_U8] column.

method.name: u16
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_U16] column.

method.name: variant
method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VARIANT] column, for a [Dictionary], an [Array] or any other value. A schema holding one cannot become a replicated table. A saved value holds data only. An [Object], [Resource], [Callable], [Signal] or [RID] is refused, including one nested inside an [Array] or a [Dictionary].

method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR2] column.

method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR3] column.

method.description: Declares a [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VECTOR4] column.
